$comment: Curated spec of 3rd-party CLI tools the plugin invokes. Bump `recommended` here in a single PR when a new upstream release lands — runners + doctor consume this file to decide whether the user's installed version is fresh. `minimum` is the lowest version that actually works for our integration; older than that, the runner refuses with a clear upgrade hint. Probes use `versionRegex` against the CLI's `--version` (or alternate `versionCommand`) output to extract a comparable semver. Keep this list lean: only tools the plugin auto-installs or auto-invokes.

gitnexus.notes: Requires Node >=22. Hooks install GitNexus into a Traffic One-managed npm prefix; runner invokes it through an absolute Node 22 binary so PATH order doesn't matter.

graphify.installCommand: Traffic One managed pipx or venv install/upgrade
graphify.notes: Python CLI. The `graphifyy` package name is intentional (not a typo) — that's how it's published on PyPI. graphify exposes NO `--version` (every form errors), so Traffic One reads the installed version from `pip show graphifyy` next to the binary, falling back to the pinned `recommended`; `versionCommand` is retained only as a forward-compatible fallback. `graphify update .` exits non-zero on a project with no code files, so onboarding gates on install (not on the first scan).

opencode.notes: OpenCode CLI used to delegate bounded, low-risk coding tasks. Hooks install it into a Traffic One-managed npm prefix; do not ask users to run the upstream curl installer. Delegation runs headless (`opencode run --format json`) on the free zero-auth `opencode/*` gateway chain in src/config/opencode.ts (OPENCODE_FREE_MODELS) — no sign-in/API key on any host; pin a different model per project via the `openCode.model` local preference.

gitleaks.notes: Used by `predeploy-security-check`. CI pins `gitleaks@v8.30.1`. Local installs need brew (macOS) or apt/release binary (Linux).

trufflehog.notes: Used by `predeploy-security-check`. CI pins `trufflehog@v3.94.3`. Local installs need brew (macOS) or the trufflesecurity release binary (Linux).
